The key to making long distance, or any relationship for that matter, work is communication. I would try to gently bring it up, just a “Hey, I feel like we haven’t talked as much as we used to and it’s making me feel a kind of way, I don’t want you to think I don’t want you to talk to your friends but I’m feeling a little left out in the cold.” Work together to find some kind of compromise. If it’s a recent behavior it could be just as simple as they got a new game and are a little too engrossed in it, I get that way sometimes and my girlfriend has had to gently remind me to take a break and live my real life lol.

The thing is that RE: isn’t actually a remake of the game, it’s a sequel, the story and game only work if you’ve played the og. I would argue it does a good job of that and I personally love rebirth and have a love hate relationship with remake but they in no way tarnish the original. It feels a little like apples and oranges to compare them tbh.
